history: Whole short/long paired datasets are resampled independently within the equally weighted G1/G3/G4 strata; no site/time pseudo-replication.
Native effects use the exact common-qualified intersection with fallback exclusion; operational RMSE retains all five completed paired fields in each mechanism.
The shared O25 [3500,4000) training-only scale is reproduced from the observations; saved normalization identities agree across conditions.
Realized observation arrays, coordinates, times and O/C/U scoring roles are checked equal across the two history conditions.
Both ESN tracks require the one-sided 95-percent bootstrap lower bound of normalized native-CRPS improvement to be at least 0.02, with at least three common-qualified pairs per scenario/track cell.
Each ESN cell must have no lower long-history qualification count; complete recorded all-roster pipeline costs must have long/short ratio at most 2.5.
A failed or insufficient gate retains 1000 without asserting absence of a data benefit; all compatible model contrasts remain reported.
sensors: The same realized observed field is checked across conditions, with nested O and fixed U.
Fitted sensor-specific bases and their spatial/temporal numerical ranks remain distinct from the diagnostic fixed 100-sensor basis.
The normalized-ridge reconstruction operator uses geometry only and reports unit-iid-noise amplification; it is not a correlated predictive-variance estimate.
One field supports descriptive sensitivity only, with no across-replication MCSE or general sensor-benefit claim.
stress: G5 uses the matched G4 generator seed family and preserves the nonintervened components; its two arms retain the declared ordinary scenario-specific fitting seed policy.
G6 preserves all pre-break observations/latent values and geometry/roles; the first affected row is final_origin+24 for lead 25.
G6 prediction uses only the original pre-origin O history, frozen model parameters and original forecast seed, with no C/U labels or post-origin conditioning.
Every original G2 score leaf is verified at the fixed 1e-10 relative/absolute tolerance before scoring the paired G6 future.
The original qualification and fallback statuses are preserved; common-qualified native effects exclude unqualified raw traces.
Both sides of each stress comparison use the same control training-only scale, with the declared metric powers.
New G5 pipeline and G6 generation/replay/scoring costs are separate; historical control costs are deduplicated; omitted G5 generation/controller overhead is explicitly scoped.
Coupled arms are not pooled as independent scenario strata; uncertainty remains exploratory with five paired fields.

review_scope: Prospective history and sensor recipe versus the current saved-artifact reduction logic.
Paired G5/G6 preparation, zero-parameter-refit G6 replay and saved-result reduction contracts.
Closure review of the selected-history provenance guard and unqualified-forecast wording.
Command signatures in the ordered reproduction guide and linked study commands.
reviewer: pro_inference_plan; independent of the study-reducer author
scope_limits: This is a source/contract review, not an executed history, sensor, stress or calibration result and not an empirical performance finding.
No claim is made that pending scientific jobs, qualification gates, numerical reductions or complete artifact inventories have already passed.
The source review does not certify universal correctness, formal bootstrap coverage, continuum fidelity, model adequacy or negligible predictive Monte Carlo error.
The earlier four focused P5 aggregation tests are separate work and are not represented as executed tests of these study reducers.

selected_history_provenance.verified: stress_prepare requires history-choice and resolved-profiles inputs; verified_revised_control binds decision identity/source/current rule, reducer and input hashes, execution-ready resolution, chosen YAML identity and initial history; read_run then requires full completed-control protocol equality.

unqualified_raw_trace_wording.verified: The guide now states that replayed unqualified raw forecasts retain failed qualification and never enter common-qualified effects.
